title: DiscoveryPrefs
description: User preferences for module discovery during memory sync. Persists which directories are accepted/rejected as modules.

exclude_patterns.description: Directory names to exclude from discovery scanning.

scan_paths.description: Specific paths to scan (null means scan from root).

max_depth.description: Maximum directory depth for recursive scanning.

module_map.description: Map of directory paths to their module classification status.

fs_path.description: Filesystem path relative to repository root.

memory_id.description: Memory entry ID (required when status is accepted).

memory_path.description: Memory file path relative to .ai-memory/ (required when status is accepted).

parent_id.description: Parent module ID when this entry is a child module.

confirmed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the decision was confirmed.

rejected_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the candidate was rejected.

reason_rejected.description: Reason the candidate was rejected (required when status is rejected).
